_comment: Single configuration file for all scripts. Edit values marked EDIT. No secrets here.
_reviewer_logins_help: EDIT: GitHub logins whose review comments are treated as high-signal for rule mining (e.g. architects). If empty, all human reviewers count equally.
_critical_paths_help: EDIT: globs of code where an error can change what a clinician sees or decides (e.g. image rendering, measurements, patient/study matching, orientation/annotation). Changes here always require human architect sign-off.
